clear.title: مسح إحصاءات حركة البيانات؟
clear.message: سيتم حذف كل السجل المسجّل نهائيًا.

notes.accuracy: يتم أخذ عينة من الاتصالات مرة كل ثانية تقريبًا. لا يمكن نسب حركة البيانات في اللحظة الأخيرة قبل إغلاق الاتصال إلى نطاق أو عملية بعينها، وتُحتسب ضمن «غير منسوب».
notes.disabled: جمع إحصاءات حركة البيانات معطّل. فعّله من الإعدادات ← متقدم.
notes.scope: Includes traffic handled by the core, including DIRECT. This is not a provider billing total.
notes.summary: Grouped by destination or process identity. Switch to Details to see strategy groups and processes.
notes.detail: Each row identifies a destination/process and its strategy group.
notes.dimensionDisabled: Collection for this dimension is disabled. Existing history remains available; enable collection in Settings → Advanced.
notes.categories: Unidentified: a connection is known but a field is missing. Unattributed: traffic with no sampled connection details. Other: rows combined for display, or details already merged in older history.
notes.topN: Showing the top 50 matches plus diagnostic categories. Remaining rows are combined. Export includes all matching saved rows.

empty: لا توجد حركة بيانات مسجّلة في هذه الفترة

filter.invalidRange: Choose up to 366 days, ending no later than today.

warnings.storage_failed: Recent data could not be saved; retry later.
warnings.read_failed: Some history files could not be read.
warnings.legacy_aggregated: Older history contains permanently merged details.
warnings.sampling_gaps: Some periods have no recorded samples.

chart.description: Traffic over time. Use the left and right arrow keys to inspect periods.

noMatches: No matching records. Try resetting groups or clearing the search.
